column1: # Known FS25 maps -> country, for the insurance region detection (tools/build_crop_insurance.py -> DB/InsuranceRegions.xml).
# Source: GIANTS ModHub map categories (survey 2026-10-16, docs/MAP_SURVEY.md); country from the map title and
# description, checked by hand. kind: real = a real place, style = fictional but clearly styled on that country,
# fictional = no country (EU = European-style, NONE = no region). Add new maps at the end; one line per mod zip.
